welcome.title: Welcome to Sekigae
welcome.subtitle: Plan lab seating right in your browser.
welcome.privacy: Your data is stored only in this browser and never sent anywhere.

sample.title: Try the sample
sample.body: Explore every feature with a sample of four labs sharing rooms.

empty.title: Start from scratch
empty.body: Begin by drawing your own rooms.

import.title: Load a backup
import.body: Resume from a JSON file you exported earlier.

help.title: Help
help.sampleConfirmBody: Your current project stays saved; the sample will be opened instead.

welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.body: Seating takes five steps. Here is a quick tour of the main features.

steps.title: Five steps
steps.body: ① Rooms → ② Members → ③ Rules → ④ Seating → ⑤ Export. Move between them anytime.

roomsList.title: Rooms
roomsList.body: Add, duplicate and reorder rooms, or start from a template.

roomsTools.title: Tools
roomsTools.body: Paint floor, outside and obstacles, then place seats and entrances. Shortcuts work too.

roomsCanvas.title: Floor
roomsCanvas.body: Drag rooms to move or resize. Scroll to zoom, hold Space and drag to pan.

members.title: Members
members.body: Manage names, labs, gender and roles. Double-click a cell to edit inline.

membersImport.title: Import
membersImport.body: Import from Excel / CSV files or paste. Last year's seats can be entered too.

rulesPalette.title: Rule blocks
rulesPalette.body: Drag room, seat, person, global and logic blocks. Templates are handy.

rulesStack.title: Rules
rulesStack.body: Choose required or preferred (weighted). Combine conditions with and / or / not.

presets.title: Presets
presets.body: Click “Mix labs”, “Seniors at the back” and more to arrange instantly while keeping your rules.

shuffle.title: Shuffle
shuffle.body: Rearrange randomly. Reuse a seed to reproduce the same result.

seatingCanvas.title: Fine-tune
seatingCanvas.body: Drag members to move or swap. Locked seats stay put when you reshuffle.

violations.title: Rule check
violations.body: Unsatisfied rules appear here. Click one to jump to the seats.

export.title: Export
export.body: Export the seating chart as XLSX or PPTX.

finish.title: You're all set!
finish.body: Replay the tour anytime from the Help menu.
